mapper.select: select fv.id, fv.name, fv.unit, fv.fee_key_id, fk.name fee_key_name from lease.fee_value fv left join lease.fee_key fk on fv.fee_key_id = fk.id and fk.is_deleted = 0 where fv.is_deleted = 0 and fv.id in (select fee_value_id from lease.apartment_fee_value where is_deleted = 0 and apartment_id = #{id})
